report.unplannedParetoHint: Machine stops recorded as unplanned, ranked by their share of the shift. Planned downtime and small stops are counted elsewhere.
report.plannedParetoHint: Stops recorded as planned — changeovers, maintenance, cleaning — ranked by their share of the shift. Planned time is subtracted from production time rather than lost against it, so it is not availability loss.
report.smallStopParetoHint: Micro-stops too short to count as downtime, ranked by their share of the shift. They are half of performance loss; reduced speed is the other half and has no per-cause records.
report.noUnplannedDowntime: No unplanned downtime recorded for this shift.

report.qualityParetoHint: Rejects recorded against each of the machine's counters, ranked by their share of the shift. The counter column is what the sensor counted, in its own unit; the converted column restates the same rejects in one unit so counters can be compared. Weight is recorded for some counters only.
report.rejectsNoParams: This shift's date could not be read, so its rejects cannot be looked up.
report.noRejects: No rejects recorded for this shift.
report.rejectsStale: Not loaded yet — the reject breakdown for this shift has not reached the reporting database.
report.rejectsError: Could not load the reject breakdown for this shift.
report.mixedUnitNote: Mixed units of measure — converted quantities are not comparable across these rows, and no shift total is shown.
report.qualityFootnote: Ranked from the shift's reject counters. These figures will not add up to the Reject tile on the report: that tile is the ETL's own aggregate on the shift row, while each row here is one counter scaled by its own conversion factor. Weight is recorded for some counters only, and Quality Loss is a duration — so neither of those is a total of this table either.
report.reworkNote: Rework is a count on the shift report with no per-reason records anywhere in the reporting database, so it cannot be ranked. It is output that was reprocessed rather than scrapped, and it is not part of the ranking above.
report.othersParetoHint: How many times each reason was cited by a downtime event in this shift. It reads the immutable event log rather than the editable downtime records, so correcting a stop's reason cannot move these bars. One stop can cite several reasons, so a bar counts the stops that mentioned a reason — it is not a share of the shift's clock. No duration is recorded per reason, which is why frequency is the only ranking here.

report.noPackaging: This SKU has no packaging set up in master data, so it can only be recorded in the line's own unit.
report.entriesSheetBody: Recorded by hand against this report, newest first. These are not included in the reported figures until the data pipeline's next run.

report.voidFailed: This entry could not be voided. It may already have been.
report.machineViewHint: Each machine's own figures, for comparing machines against each other. They do not add up to the line's totals above — a line is measured at its own count points, not summed from its machines.
report.rankedFromDowntime: Ranked from recorded downtime records. Totals here need not match the {{loss}} figure on the report, which is the ETL's own aggregate.
report.loadMachineBreakdown: Could not load the machine breakdown for this report.
report.noMachineOnLine: No machine reported into this line for this window.
report.editDowntimeBody: Changes are recorded against your name and shown in this stop's change history.
report.categoryMovesTime: Changing the category moves time between schedule loss and availability loss, so the report's OEE totals are recalculated by the pipeline.
report.reasonsFromLine: Reasons come from this line's master data. The first reason is the one the Pareto groups this stop under.
report.downtimeUpdatedRefresh: Downtime updated. The report's totals will refresh when the pipeline recalculates.
report.detailDowntimeBody: The full record behind one stop, as the reporting database holds it.
report.reasonDetailFootnote: Durations are clipped to this shift, so they sum to the bar this page was opened from — not to the {{loss}} figure on the report, which is the ETL's own aggregate.
report.mixedUnitsNoAverage: Mixed units of measure — no shift average. Per-product figures are shown with each chart.
report.hourlyNotLoaded: Not loaded yet — the hourly data for this report has not reached the reporting database.
report.hourlyHintShift: Actual and effective output for each hour of the shift, against the product's master rate. This is the evidence behind Reduce Speed, which has no per-cause breakdown of its own.
report.hourlyDescShift: Actual and effective output for each hour of the shift, against the product's master rate.
report.hourlyDescDay: Actual and effective output for each hour of the day, against the product's master rate.
report.hourlyDescMonth: Every occurrence of each clock hour across the month, collapsed into 24 points, against the product's master rate.
report.hourlyLoadShift: Could not load the hourly production detail for this shift.
report.hourlyLoadReport: Could not load the hourly production detail for this report.
report.hourlyLoadLine: Could not load the hourly production detail for this line.
report.lineHourlyDescShift: What came off the end of the line each hour of the shift, against the product's master rate. Infeed is counted in a different unit and is not shown here.
report.lineHourlyDescDay: What came off the end of the line each hour of the day, against the product's master rate. Infeed is counted in a different unit and is not shown here.
report.lineHourlyDescMonth: What came off the end of the line in every occurrence of each clock hour across the month, collapsed into 24 points, against the product's master rate. Infeed is counted in a different unit and is not shown here.
report.unitsBreakdownHint: Each line's own counters, grouped by the unit it counts in. These figures are NOT totalled and NOT comparable across rows — a bag and a sack hold different amounts. The Area Overview above converts everything to weight, which is the one figure that can be added up.
report.infeedCaption: What the area's lines consumed, in the unit each counts in.
report.outputCaption: What the area's lines shipped, in the unit each counts in.
report.lineExcludedOne: 1 line is excluded: the pipeline has not resolved its {{side}} unit, so its counts are not in any row above.
report.linesExcluded: {{count}} lines are excluded: the pipeline has not resolved their {{side}} unit, so their counts are not in any row above.
report.reduceSpeedNote: No per-cause records exist for reduce-speed loss, so it cannot be ranked. The Trendline view is the evidence behind this figure — actual output against the product's master rate, hour by hour. A negative total means the machine outran its standard rate.
report.areaNoHourly: An area has no hourly curve of its own — summing its lines' hours would not match the totals above.
report.othersFootnote: Ranked from the shift's downtime event log, counted by how many stops cited each reason. A stop can cite more than one reason, {{counted}}. Neither figure is the Downtime Frequency on the report, which counts the editable downtime records across every category. No duration appears here: the log records that a reason was cited, not how long it lasted.
report.othersFootnoteCounted: so these bars sum to reason occurrences, not to the downtime events they came from
report.othersFootnoteCountedNums: so these bars sum to {{occurrences}} reason occurrences, not to the {{events}} downtime events they came from
